definitions.explanation: The process of converting waste materials into new products or resources.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧リサイクル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I put out plastic bottles for recycling.

examples.japanese: リサイクルできる⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Products using recyclable materials are increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧リサイクル⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This city has a high recycling rate.

notes:
リサイクル is a loanword from English "recycle."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- リサイクルに⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ - to put out for recycling
- リサイクル⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ - recyclable
- リサイクル⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ - recycling rate
- リサイクル⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ - recycled goods
- リサイクルショップ - secondhand shop, thrift store

SURU-VERB USAGE:
[object]をリサイクルする - to recycle [object]

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{分別|ぶんべつ}→分別：07706_bunbetsu⟧ - sorting (of garbage)
- ⟦{再利用|さいりよう}→再利用：18649_sairiyou⟧ - reuse
- エコ - eco (ecological)
- ⟦{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧ - waste

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has extensive recycling programs. Many municipalities require residents to sort garbage into detailed categories, and リサイクルショップ (secondhand shops) are common.
